author: abdulmajeedv111
quote: The game is extremely repetitive in terms of gameplay—which is the most important aspect of any game. I don’t understand why reviewers didn’t focus on this in their assessments. If the focus is solely on the story and graphics, why bother playing at all, when we already have movies and TV shows? They ended up commenting on the peripheral elements of any video game while ignoring the most essential part.
